TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY MAY 20, 2026 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In
order to conduct the meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to
discuss their concerns within a 3­minute time allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure
everyone wishing to speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate your understanding and
cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394­6240 or email at
publicworks@sandimasca.gov.
COMMITTEE MEMBERS
Shari Garwick (Director of Public Works) Steve Barragan (Engineering Manager, Public Works Dept.),
Esau Ramos (Manager, Maintenance Yard), Rose Lee (Manager of Special Assignments,
BUSD) Detective Guillen (San Dimas Sheriff’s Department), Ruben Perales (Traffic Engineer),
Genevieve Amaro (Management Aide, Public Works Dept.)

INTRODUCTIONS

DISCUSSION ITEMS

05­26­01­Juanita Ave & San Dimas Canyon Road Crosswalk Concern
Request from resident, to review current crosswalk visibility and possible enhancement
options.
05­26­02­Terrebonne Ave Pedestrian Concern near SD Golf Course
Request from resident, to review and consider the removal of red curb along Terrebonne
Ave (near San Dimas Golf Course)
05­26­03­Parking Concern surrounding Civic Center Park
Request from Code Compliance Department, to review and consider installation of red
curb at the following intersection approaches:
1st and Iglesia NE corner & SW corner
2nd and Walnut SW corner
2nd and Iglesias SW corner & NW corner
05­26­04­Cataract Ave & Arrow Hwy Left Turning Lane Concern
Request from resident, review the current left turn lane along Arrow Hwy.
05­26­05­Juanita Ave & Basilio Ave Crosswalk Pedestrian Concern
Request from resident, review and consider installation of stop sign at current crosswalk.
05­26­06­Perceived Speeding Concern on E 4th Street Between San Dimas Ave &
Walnut Ave.
Request from resident, review and consider options to reduce perceived speeding
concerns along E 4th Street
 2nd and Walnut SW corner
2nd and Iglesias SW corner & NW corner
05­26­04­Cataract Ave & Arrow Hwy Left Turning Lane Concern
Request from resident, review the current left turn lane along Arrow Hwy.
05­26­05­Juanita Ave & Basilio Ave Crosswalk Pedestrian Concern
Request from resident, review and consider installation of stop sign at current crosswalk.
05­26­06­Perceived Speeding Concern on E 4th Street Between San Dimas Ave &
Walnut Ave.
Request from resident, review and consider options to reduce perceived speeding
concerns along E 4th Street
05­26­07­Street Lighting Concern along S San Dimas Ave
Request from resident, to review and consider installation of additional lighting along San
Dimas Ave south of Via Vaquero to the 57 Fwy overpass.
05­26­08­Pedestrian Crossing Concern along Juanita Avenue from Shellman to
Rennell and Shellman Avenue from Juanita to Gladstone
Request from resident, to review and consider the installation of crosswalks along Juanita
and Shellman Ave.
05­26­09­San Dimas Ave Public Parking areas for Grove Station Request for
Safety Improvements
Request from San Dimas Grove Station HOA, to review and consider installation of
bollards.
05­26­10 Cars and Coffee
Request from staff, to review TTCP
05­26­11 Booster Car Show
Request from applicant, to review TTCP & COA.

CONTINUED ITEMS

03­26­07 Fourth of July Celebration
Request from staff, review TTCP and COA.
03­26­01 Gladstone St. Left Turn Queuing Concern at RR Crossing
Request from resident, to review design options for currently painted median
11­25­05 Baseline Road Speed Limit Concern
Request from resident, review Baseline Road speed limit from Amelia Ave to San Dimas
Ave.
03­26­08 N San Dimas Ave and Baseline Road
Request from staff, review San Dimas Ave & Baseline Road intersection.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

  at (909) 394­6216. Early notification before the meeting you wish to attend will make it

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if
  you need assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office
  at (909) 394­6216. Early notification before the meeting you wish to attend will make it
  possible for the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
  meeting [28 CFR 35.102­35.104 ADA Title II].

Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any
writings or documents provided to the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made
available for public review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from 7:30
a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Public Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the
City's website at www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on May 14, 2026, I posted a true and
correct copy of this agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita
Ave., and on the City's website www.sandimasca.gov/agendas­minutes/as required by law.

  Genevieve Amaro
May 14, 2026
  Genevieve Amaro, Management Aide
